title: Verbs of Absorption, Immersion, and Self-Actualization

sections.title: Contrast Between Illative (-ba/-be) and Inessive (-ban/-ben) Absorption
sections.content: When describing mental focus in B2 Hungarian, pay close attention to the prefix-case harmony of two key verbs: 1) belefeledkezik a munkába ('loses oneself INTO the work', illative -ba/-be echoing bele-); 2) elmélyül a feladatban ('immerses oneself IN the task', inessive -ban/-ben). Meanwhile, eluralkodik ('takes control over / overwhelms') takes the superessive (-on/-en/-ön): 'Eluralkodik rajtunk a szorongás' (Anxiety takes hold over us).

sections.title: Inchoative Verbs in -edik/-odik for Personal Growth
sections.content: Adjectives and participles can form middle/inchoative verbs in -edik/-odik meaning 'becomes increasingly X': teljes ('complete') → kiteljesedik ('fulfills oneself / reaches full potential'), gazdag ('rich') → gazdagodik ('becomes richer'). These verbs provide high-register equivalents for English 'flourish' and 'self-actualize'.

sections.title: Absorption & Growth Verbs with Their Case Frames
rows: Az alkotó teljesen belefeledkezik a festésbe.
A kutató órákra elmélyül a kísérletben.
Túl nehéz feladatnál eluralkodik rajtunk a szorongás.
Az ember az alkotó munkában teljesedik ki.

items.spanish: Amikor egy alkotó teljesen belefeledkezik a tevékenységébe, megszűnik számára az időérzék.
items.english: When a creator completely loses themselves in their activity, the sense of time ceases for them.

items.spanish: Ha a kihívás túl nagy a tudásunkhoz képest, eluralkodik rajtunk a szorongás.
items.english: If the challenge is too great compared to our skill, anxiety takes hold of us.

items.spanish: Az ember akkor teljesedik ki, ha értelmes célokért küzdve elmélyülhet a munkájában.
items.english: A person reaches full potential when, striving for meaningful goals, they can immerse themselves in their work.

sections.title: B2 Usage Notice
sections.content: Memorize the contrast: belefeledkezik a játékba (-ba/-be: movement into forgetful absorption) vs. elmélyül a gondolataiban (-ban/-ben: deep immersion inside thoughts).
